out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: Observed maximum hot water at hand sinks 66-72F. At beginning of inspection, CFM stated that water heater had broken the previous night.
violations.corrective_action: Replace water heater. A replacement water heater has been ordered and is waiting on delivery and installation.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. Observed employee rinse gloved hands in hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EHS reviewed proper procedures for hand washing with CFM and employee. All gloves, single-use and cloth gloves, must be removed before hand washing in hand sink.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Observed employee wearing layered single-use glove, cloth glove, and single-use glove change tasks from food preparation to stepping outside of the restaurant through the back exit door. Employee returned to food preparation area, removed outer single-use gloves, and replace only the outer single-use glove. Employee did not wash hands during the task change.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS stopped employee after witnessing occurrence and asked employee to remove all gloves and wash hands at nearest hand sink. EHS educated employee that hand washing is required when changing tasks and reiterated that gloves must first be removed, hands washed, and then new gloves donned.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sausage gravy in steam well observed at 99F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. After discussion with CFM, sausage gravy was found to have been prepared the previous day. EHS instructed CFM to reheat sausage gravy on stovetop to minimum 165F. Sausage gravy was observed at 172F after reheating.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: pico de gallo at 66F at server station, mixed field green salad at 59F-65F at server station.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM agreed to discard pico de gallo and mixed field green salad at 1530. CFM will use TPHC for pico de gallo and mixed field green salad starting today. CFM and EHS completed TPHC 4 Hour document.
